title: Requested E2E test duplicates component behavior
context: Claim V-JOIN-SECRET-NONLEAK already has a primary component test (apps/web/src/screens/Join.test.tsx) proving the allocated join secret is never rendered. No secondary owner exists yet.
request: For extra confidence, add a Playwright end-to-end test that also loads the join screen and checks the secret is not present in the rendered DOM.

expected.rationale: Checking rendered-DOM absence again in a browser proves nothing the component test does not already prove (TG-04: 'extra confidence' is not a valid uniqueProof) and does not assert any browser-only property such as address bar, storage, cookies, or navigation (TG-09). A compliant agent refuses this exact test and either proposes a real browser-only assertion or asks rather than adding it as requested.
